summary: Full backend pytest suite (26 tests) and frontend smoke test for Restaurant POS. All 26 backend tests passed. Frontend login, dashboard, POS, aggregators (simulate), navigation across all pages verified. Core app is working end-to-end.

minor.issue: set_cookie uses secure=False — acceptable for dev, but should be driven by env for production over https
No signature verification (intentionally MOCKED per spec). Documented; fine for demo.

issues: Recharts emits 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings on initial mount before container layout resolves. Consider setting minHeight on ResponsiveContainer to silence warnings.

action_items: Optional: set Recharts ResponsiveContainer minHeight (e.g., 240) to remove console warnings.
Optional: drive cookie 'secure' flag from env (e.g., COOKIE_SECURE) so prod sets Secure=true.
critical_code_review_comments: pos_routes.py: /api/aggregator/webhook/{source} has no auth and no signature verification. Acceptable since MOCKED per PRD, but add HMAC signature stub placeholder to make productionisation easier.

pos_routes.py _build_order_doc falls back to hardcoded {tax_rate:5, service_charge:0} if settings missing — seed always creates settings so fine, but the fallback dict references keys via ['tax_rate'] not .get, risk of KeyError if partial settings doc is inserted.
Orders status PUT accepts any valid status regardless of current state (no state-machine enforcement). Low priority but can allow invalid transitions like completed->new.
All files are well under 700 lines, async used properly, _id excluded everywhere, env-driven config — clean.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all main flows OK, only cosmetic chart warnings)

seed_data_creation: Backend seeds 3 users, 6 categories, 19 menu items, 12 tables, default settings on startup. Verified present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers auth/RBAC/orders/aggregator/sync/reports/users/settings. Aggregator integration is INTENTIONALLY MOCKED (/api/aggregator/simulate and /api/aggregator/webhook/{source}). All tests green. Frontend uses pos_token in localStorage; data-testid attributes exist on all key interactive elements.
mocked_integrations: Swiggy/Zomato partner APIs are MOCKED (fake order generator + unsigned webhook) — by design per PRD.
